answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The gale of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, reset on any identity-link attempt. The nadir is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the atlas.
